messages:
Camila Reyes: customer asking where to rotate a Hosted API key  do we have a canonical doc?
Dev Patel: yep  Console  Settings > API Keys > regenerate. then deploy new key + disable old.
Avery Johnson: linking internal page: confluence/eng-developer-experience/docs-site/hosted-api-key-rotation-and-revocation  has both console + API steps
SupportBot: :link: Suggested macro: "Hosted API key rotation & revocation (customer guide)"
Camila Reyes: also remind them not to paste keys in the ticket. if they suspect compromise, disable first.
Dev Patel: +1. if they claim revoke didn't take immediately, ask for request ids  but usually resolves in <60s
